inspiration.observed_pattern: A MySQL migration adds a VIRTUAL generated VARBINARY prefix column using LEFT, CAST(... AS BINARY), and COALESCE so a nullable text namespace can be indexed safely.
inspiration.mysql_mariadb_translation: Rewritten as an independently authored label registry migration. An ALTER TABLE adds a VIRTUAL binary prefix derived from a nullable utf8mb4 namespace, and ordered reads expose the generated bytes for ordinary, NULL, and multibyte namespaces. The source table, identifiers, values, migration guard, index-oriented naming, and application purpose are new.

fixture_notes: Namespaces 1 and 2 exercise ordinary and NULL input; namespace 3 begins with multibyte text. The generated VARBINARY prefix is limited to 12 bytes, and HEX plus OCTET_LENGTH make byte truncation observable.
determinism_notes: All labels, namespaces, generated-column width, and ordering are fixed; no clocks, randomness, sleeps, or concurrent connections are used.
setup: CREATE TABLE label_registry (label_id INT PRIMARY KEY, namespace VARCHAR(64) CHARACTER SET utf8mb4 NULL, label_name VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL)
INSERT INTO label_registry (label_id, namespace, label_name) VALUES (1, 'dept/alpha', 'North'), (2, NULL, 'Unscoped'), (3, '漢字/blue', 'Unicode')

steps.sql: ALTER TABLE label_registry ADD COLUMN namespace_prefix VARBINARY(12) GENERATED ALWAYS AS (LEFT(CAST(COALESCE(namespace, '') AS BINARY), 12)) VIRTUAL
SELECT label_id, namespace, label_name, HEX(namespace_prefix) AS prefix_hex, OCTET_LENGTH(namespace_prefix) AS prefix_bytes FROM label_registry ORDER BY label_id
